name: Consciousness After Death
overview: Scripture reveals that death is the consequence of sin, as God declared in Genesis 2:17 that the day one eats from the forbidden tree, they shall surely die. At death, the body returns to the earth while the spirit returns to God who gave it (Ecclesiastes 12:7). The dead are described as having no consciousness or knowledge, with no remembrance or reward, emphasizing a state of unconsciousness in the grave (Psalms 6:5, Ecclesiastes 9:5). However, the narrative of the rich man in Luke 16:19 suggests a conscious existence after death, indicating that the righteous and the wicked experience different realities beyond the grave.
